description: pkix-chain has crl and ocsp Cargo features that activate pkix-revocation/crl and pkix-revocation/ocsp. But pkix-chain::lib.rs only re-exports NoRevocation and RevocationChecker from pkix-revocation. A user who enables pkix-chain/crl and wants use pkix_chain::CrlChecker; will get a compile error. They must add pkix-revocation as a direct dependency and use pkix_revocation::CrlChecker. This defeats the point of the umbrella crate's convenience.
title: pkix-chain: crl/ocsp features don't re-export CrlChecker/OcspChecker
